title: plexWell LP384 Part 3
author: Opentrons
materials: Every six columns from the SBP96 plates are pooled into one column of a clean, 96-well plate (columns 1-6 of SBP96 plate 1 are pooled into column 1 of clean plate; columns 7-12 of SBP96 plate 1 are pooled into column 2 of clean plate; columns 1-6 of SBP96 plate 2 are pooled into column 3 of clean plate, etc). --- * [plexWell LP 384 Kit](https://seqwell.com/products/plexwell-lp-384/) - SBP96 Plate, containing samples from [Part 2](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/0961d2-part2) * [Opentrons P10 Multi Channel Pipette](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/ot-2-robot/products/8-channel-electronic-pipette) * [Bio-Rad 96-Well Plate, 200µL PCR](https://labware.opentrons.com/biorad_96_wellplate_200ul_pcr?category=wellPlate), clean and empty * [Opentrons 10µL Filter Tips](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/opentrons-tips/products/opentrons-10ul-filter-tip) --- Slot
Bio-Rad Plate, clean and empty Slot
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Arrange deck as specified
steps.instruction: Place Opentrons 10 µL filter tip racks in slots 1, 4, 7, and 10 (optional). Place SBP96 plates containing samples in slots 2, 5, 8, and 11 (optional). Place a clean Bio‑Rad 96‑well PCR plate (200 µL capacity) in slot 3. Leave slots 6 and 9 empty.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: In the OT‑2 app, input the number of SBP96 plates you will process (choose a value between 1 and 4) and any other required parameters for the SB Pooling step.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Click the “Download” button to obtain the generated OT‑2 Python protocol for this part of the plexWell LP‑384 workflow.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Open the OT‑2 app and upload the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑2 app, run calibration for each labware slot (tip racks, SBP96 plates, clean plate) and for the Opentrons P10 multi‑channel pipette, following the standard calibration workflow.

steps.title: Pool SBP96 columns
steps.instruction: Run the uploaded protocol. The robot will pool every six columns of each SBP96 plate into a single column of the clean 96‑well plate as follows: columns 1‑6 of SBP96 plate 1 → column 1 of clean plate; columns 7‑12 of SBP96 plate 1 → column 2; columns 1‑6 of SBP96 plate 2 → column 3; columns 7‑12 of SBP96 plate 2 → column 4; and so on for up to four SBP96 plates.

steps.title: Complete run
steps.instruction: After the robot finishes, verify that the pooled samples are correctly placed in the designated columns of the clean Bio‑Rad plate.
